integrity: A uniform Bézout and blow-up proof is supplied with a bounded exact arithmetic checker. No independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Valid for complex Fermat–Ceva arrangements with integer m at least two and exactly two positive constant point-stratum weights.
No assertion that the two families exhaust wall minimizers, nor that all singular fibers or the full nef cone are classified.
Priority comparison remains conditional on inspected and indexed literature; independent scientific evaluation is not performed.
title: Two-weight Seshadri walls and an isotropic pencil on Fermat–Ceva blow-ups
